name: 10 EMA trend pullback (5-min): opposite-colour candle that stays off the 10 EMA, enter on its break
why: YouTube video sent by Mandeep, 13 Nov 2026 ('10 EMA', Anant Ladha with Pushkar Raj Thakur): above the 10 EMA a red candle not touching it is the trigger, the next candle breaking its high = buy; below, a green candle not touching it, break of its low = sell; stop = the 10 EMA; target 1:2. Option selling: sell the out-of-the-money option at the 10 EMA level, premium stop 15-30%. Claims: 3 of 4-5 trades right, 1:7-1:10 easily. Index pre-test 2022-2026 (research 0005): won 37-40%, 1:2 reached 28-30%, +2.2 to +3.3 index points a trade before option costs. Not proven.
source: Video: 10 EMA strategy (Mandeep 13 Nov 2026), Tanu research 0005
